preconditions.description: The number of testcases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each testcase, the number of permutations n must be between 1 and 50,000, and the length of each permutation m must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a_i) == m and set(a_i) == set(range(1, m + 1)) for a_i in permutations)
preconditions.description: Each permutation must have length m and contain distinct integers from 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output)
postconditions.description: The output must contain n integers, each representing the largest beauty of a permutation a_i * a_j for all j.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= m for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value must be a non-negative integer not exceeding m.
